items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED LESSONS (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse); bombs damage self; warp away does NOT outrun fuse. Q/Space do nothing. Mixing a movement key with a fire arrow moves+shoots simultaneously. Diagonal moves stall on rocks whose hitboxes exceed sprites — reposition lanes rather than pushing.

TECH X: pill pedestal in two-poop room grants Tech X ('Laser ring tears'); re-offered on re-entry (confirmed again this run, still 3 hearts at pickup). Firing makes a ~1s lingering laser ring at fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, NOT a lock marker or telegraph (uncertain). Lasers kill white-faced chasers safely at range only when aimed down the correct row/column.

KEYS: keys counter 00 this run; no key pickup observed. Earlier runs saw 01 without visible pickup, and 00 even after a key-shaped pickup. Whether 01 opens the rock-field keyhole door is UNTESTED. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers suspected key-locked (guess).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS — NEW FAILED TEST: the dark chest room's two red-lidded UNspiked chests (upper-left ~(0.33,0.33), upper-right ~(0.67,0.33)) do NOT open on player contact; approaching the upper-left one cost a heart (likely a nearby chaser, not the chest). Gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in TNT room are inert decor (confirmed). Coin pot in two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin — don't waste lasers. Torch-room center gray chest sealed by indestructible rocks (tested left/top/right) — ABANDON. Central spiked chest in dark chest room is untouchable.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing. Never bomb at low hearts or adjacent to self. Rocks judged indestructible.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact; they transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and a large white-faced blob form exists. Rock field is a severe heart-drainer; enemies cluster near hatches. Observed there: small spiky pellet projectiles (guess: turret bottom-right), spiked-wheel wall decor, white-faced chasers, blue-tear shooters, a spiked-ring enemy, a gray round enemy near the top hatch, and a spiky black rock ring with a gray enemy inside at room center. Corner torches damage on touch. Dark chest room: small black creatures/chasers plus black blob/pit shapes at y~0.48 — contact is costly; chasers deal damage fast.

NEW DEATH LESSON (this run): starting with full 3 hearts + Tech X, I entered the dark chest room and dropped to 0 hearts within seconds — a small dark creature reached me at the upper-left chest and the damage cascaded (a white-faced enemy then approached). Entering enemy rooms without first thinning enemies from the doorway is fatal. Standing adjacent to containers while creatures roam is unsafe.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times this run): requires near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame; standing ON the frame blocks warp — back off ~0.15-0.3, re-center, then hold the direction. Multiple attempts normal; on failure back off and re-center rather than pressing harder.

MAP / ROUTES (all listed hatches confirmed working):
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49-0.50 <-> torch room; right doorway y~0.47 <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch <-> tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48.
- Torch room: top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.16-0.18 <-> tutorial; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76-0.79 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above); safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height clears the central rock cluster; right lane x~0.63 traversable down.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50, y~0.12 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate and drop nothing; center rock indestructible; Tech X pedestal at center.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot at close range); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies, rock wall right with a poop pile containing gold/blue flies, three dark teardrop pickups, gray chest with spiky black edges at left. Pink enemy behavior UNTESTED.
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): chaser den; two red-lidded unspiked chests (upper-left, upper-right), central red-lidded spiked chest, black blob/pit shapes, gold/olive specks; small dark creatures patrol upper-right.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource; survival gates everything else. Preferred opener: Tech X first (tutorial bottom hatch -> torch room left lane -> gold hatch -> two-poop room -> back up), since Tech X is reliably obtained at full hearts. Then only enter enemy rooms after clearing/Thinning enemies from the doorway with lasers.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the red-lidded unspiked chests (keys? shooting? something else — contact failed); whether key counter 01 actually unlocks the rock-field keyhole door; contents of the torch-room enclosed chest; nature of the dark teardrop pickups in the pink room; green blob effect beyond heart loss; exact coin pickup tolerance; whether lasers open any chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); whether hearts can be regained anywhere; whether the dark chest room's black blobs are hazards or terrain.
